settings/unlockBitrateMax.title: Unlock max bitrate
settings/unlockBitrateMax.body: Raise the selectable bitrate limits for each resolution. This does not force the console to deliver the selected rate.

settings/ipcStats.title: IPC stats
settings/ipcStats.body: Expose live stream statistics through Akira's IPC service for the external overlay and debugging tools.

settings/portGuessing.title: Port guessing
settings/portGuessing.body: Probe extra ports to improve NAT traversal on strict networks.

settings/portGuessingCount.title: Port guess count
settings/portGuessingCount.body: How many candidate ports to probe.

settings/portGuessingSocks.title: Probe socket count
settings/portGuessingSocks.body: How many sockets to open while probing.

settings/autoReconnect.title: Auto reconnect
settings/autoReconnect.body: Offer to reconnect a dropped direct Remote Play session when Akira regains focus. Cloud sessions are excluded.

settings/hideAccountName.title: Hide account name
settings/hideAccountName.body: Mask PSN account names and identifiers throughout Akira to make screenshots safer to share.

settings/psnRequestBudget.title: PSN request budget
settings/psnRequestBudget.body: Maximum number of governed PSN requests allowed within the configured request window. Higher values increase the risk of server throttling.

settings/psnRequestWindow.title: PSN request window
settings/psnRequestWindow.body: Rolling time window used by the PSN request limiter. Changing it reconfigures the trophy and party limiters.

settings/runBenchmark.title: Run benchmark
settings/runBenchmark.body: Measure GHASH cryptographic throughput on this Switch.

settings/flushTrophyCache.title: Flush trophy cache
settings/flushTrophyCache.body: Delete cached trophy summaries, lists, and details. Akira fetches them again when needed.
